name: doggo-observer
description: Observe a bounded scope and report evidence, inference, and gaps without taking action.

interface.longDescription: Apply DOGGO's Genesis observation contract to a scope and evidence supplied by the user. Separate directly supported observations from labelled inferences, compare against explicit criteria, expose missing evidence, and stop after reporting.
defaultPrompt: Observe this supplied scope and evidence under the DOGGO Genesis contract.
Compare these observations against my stated criteria and report gaps.
